fields.name: signature_1
fields.meaning: Format signature text '01-11-27 V1.50   BANDAI / STING '. If it (or the second copy) does not match, the whole save area 0x1000-0x792C is erased and the signatures rewritten
fields.evidence: code: 4000:c040 compares with ROM 7000:F3B0 and wipes on mismatch; ROM bytes match exactly

fields.name: last_slot
fields.meaning: Number of the slot used for the last save or load (0 = file 1 .. 4 = file 5); the file list opens on this slot
fields.evidence: code: written 4000:c148 (save), 4000:c1c8 (load); read 2000:d6ba to place the cursor; diff: 0, 1, 2 after saving to files 1, 2, 3

fields.name: slot_status
fields.meaning: File status byte. 0 = empty; 1 = alternate save kind (written by the 4000:b962 menu path; loading it with a nonzero chapter takes a special branch at 4000:b69e); 2 = normal save (map menu 4000:615a); bit 0x10 = damaged (set when both copies fail the checksum)
fields.evidence: code: 4000:c153 writes caller's AL; callers pass 1 (b97a) and 2 (615a); 4000:c0d6/c261 test low nibble; 4000:c108 sets 0x10; 4000:b812 shows empty/damaged/file text; diff: 0 -> 2 on save

fields.name: scenario
fields.meaning: Chapter id counted from 0; 0 shows as chapter 1 (だい1わ) in the file list. Used as an index into ROM data tables; scenario 3/5/11 get multi-phase setup
fields.evidence: code: table index in 4000:b3e9/bbec/bcbe; diff/screen: 0 with だい1わ

fields.name: table_d000
fields.meaning: 32 unit records of 32 bytes (first byte 0xFF = empty). Used records hold a type id, map coordinates (X at +8, Y at +10 as 16-bit), flag bytes at +0xE/+0x12, and a stationed-castle index at +0x16; 4 in use
fields.evidence: code: 4000:b3e9 walks all three (FF test, +1/+0xE/+0x12/+0x16 uses); diff/coords match map scale

fields.name: table_d400
fields.meaning: 34 general records of 32 bytes (first byte = id, 0xFF = empty). Records gain map coordinates month to month and a new record appeared after a month; 8 in use
fields.evidence: diff: coordinates fill in (+8/+10), record with id 0x0C spawned; code bases per first pass (4000:3bce/4212/4870)

fields.name: table_d840
fields.meaning: 16 castle records of 16 bytes: owner side at +0 (1 = player), best garrisoned unit type/rating at +4/+5, monthly countdown at +0xD (ticks down by 1 each month except the player's first castle)
fields.evidence: code: 4000:b3e9 reads owner/+4/+5; diff: +0xD decremented in records 1-15 after one month

fields.name: backup_files
fields.meaning: Backup copy of all five files (each file's copy sits 0x3480 bytes after it). It has no checksums of its own: when CONTINUE is opened, a file whose checksum fails is restored from this copy and checked again
fields.evidence: code: save copies the file to +0x3480 (4000:c1ab); boot restore 4000:c0ef; diff: copies identical to files

fields.name: resume_flag
fields.meaning: Story resume flag: set to 1 by an event-script opcode, tested when the title screen is built, cleared when no file is in use. 0 in every save observed (CONTINUE still works with 0)
